title: Proof queue: scalar casts and selects
selection_note: Pending source-local scalar cast and select rules, ranked from type/bit identities through i1 cases and min/max clamps. External cast-pair tables and arbitrary SSA analysis are excluded. Poison notes call out non-strict select behavior, source flag dropping, and absent undef guards where relevant.
